title: Oozy Cheese Pull Ethiopian Banana Injera
description: A yeasty, cheese-pull Ethiopian dish featuring banana, made in a tandoor and halal-friendly, formed into injera.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and mix well.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and knead for 5 minutes.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the tandoor or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 4 equal parts and roll each part into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a few slices of banana in the center of each injera, leaving a 1 inch border around.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the banana slices.
Fold the injera in half to enclose the filling and cook for 2 minutes on each side.
Brush the injera with melted butter and sprinkle with tandoori masala.
Serve hot and enjoy the oozy cheese pull.
